defs.def: a short distance away 距离近；不远

ex.s: Which hotel is nearest to the stadium?
ex.t: 哪家酒店离体育场最近？

ex.s: Once the book you've requested is delivered to the nearest branch, they will inform you by e-mail, so you can pick it up.
ex.t: 一旦你借的书送到最近的分馆，他们会通过电子邮件通知你，这样你就可以去取了。

ex.s: Her voice was soft but confident as she pointed to the corner near the windows.
ex.t: "我工作效率很高，"她说。

ex.s: By Rail: The nearest station is Cark-in-Cartmel with trains to Carnforth, Lancaster Preston for connections to major cities & airports.
ex.t: 乘火车：最近的车站是卡克因卡特梅尔，有开往卡恩弗斯、兰开斯特和普雷斯顿的列车，可转车前往主要城市和机场。

ex.s: •Exit immediately from the nearest emergency exit；do not use a lift．
ex.t: •立即从最近的紧急出口撤离；不要使用电梯。

ex.s: B． To lead the students to the nearest exits．
ex.t: B． 把学生们带到最近的出口。

defs.def: a short time away in the future 不久以后

ex.s: Mike Curtin sees my arugula story all the time — but for him, it's more like 12 bones of donated strawberries nearing their last days.
ex.t: Mike Curtin总是看到我的芝麻菜故事——但对他来说，那更像12盒快过期的捐赠草莓。

ex.s: In the near future，it's not just going to be the number you see on your screen that will be in doubt.
ex.t: 成功意味着满足个人欲望

ex.s: The team hopes to make it to market in the near future.
ex.t: 该团队希望在不久的将来将其推向市场。

defs.def: coming next after sb/sth 随后；接近

ex.s: Baggy has become the first dog in the UK—and potentially the world—to join the fight against air pollution by recording pollutant levels near the ground.
ex.t: 它的监测器显示，越接近地面，空气污染程度越高，这突显了一个令人担忧的问题：婴儿和幼儿患肺部疾病的风险可能更高。

ex.s: This was near the end of America's Westward Expansion, which started in the early 1800 During the expansion, many people went to the West to make money.
ex.t: 这发生在美国西进运动接近尾声的时候，该运动始于 19 世纪初。在扩张期间，许多人前往西部赚钱。

defs.def: similar; most similar 近似；相似；不分伯仲
close to being sb/sth 无比较级或最高级
at a short distance away 距离不远；在附近

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

defs.def: a short time away in the future 不久以后
almost 尤用于构成复合词
at a short distance away from sb/sth 在 … 附近；靠近

ex.s: It’s situated near a big island.
ex.t: 它坐落在一个大岛附近。

ex.s: One day, while driving near her home, she saw a dog wandering on the road, clearly lost.
ex.t: 一天，在她家附近开车时，她看到一只狗在路上游荡，显然迷路了。

ex.s: As he was ___25___ that it would be too warm, he ___26___ it out on the table near an open window.
ex.t: 当他____25____觉得太暖和时____26____ 他在窗外的桌子上

ex.s: The village lay near some wetlands which became his second   21   .
ex.t: 这个村庄位于一些湿地附近，那里成了他的第二个____21____。

ex.s: Vinnie wanted to choose the corner near the windows to ______. （    ）
ex.t: Vinnie想选择靠近窗户的角落来______。（    ）

ex.s: 38     In these places patients can go to be near nature during their recovery.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 38     在这些地方，患者可以在康复期间亲近大自然。

ex.s: Wilson will drive to the nearest store and purchase what's needed.
ex.t: 如果他们在注册方面有问题，

ex.s: New York City, for example, is near a large harbour at the mouth of the Hudson River.
ex.t: 例如，纽约市就位于哈德逊河入海口附近的一个大港口旁。

ex.s: B． gather at the nearest exit
ex.t: B． 在最近的出口处集合。

ex.s: The lockers are located in Building 1 near the Information Desk and in Building 3.
ex.t: 储物柜位于1号楼，靠近问讯台，以及3号楼。

ex.s: If you’re lucky, there might be a pocket park near where you live, but it’s unusual to find places in a city that are relatively wild.
ex.t: 如果幸运，你住的地方附近可能有一个袖珍公园，但在城市里找到相对野生的地方是不寻常的。

ex.s: She wanted to work near her home.
ex.t: 她想在家附近工作。

ex.s: While Spain as a whole is heating up quickly, temperatures near the greenhouses have decreased.
ex.t: 虽然西班牙整体在迅速升温，但温室附近的气温却下降了。

ex.s: Is there a bookshop near here?
ex.t: 这附近有书店吗？

ex.s: Do not stand near street lights or under power lines.
ex.t: 不要站在路灯下或电线下面。

ex.s: What they needed was a well dug near their homes.
ex.t: 他们需要的是在家附近挖一口井。

ex.s: After several months, Ryan had raised the $2,000, with which a well was built near a primary school in Uganda.
ex.t: 几个月后，瑞安筹到了2000美元，用这笔钱在乌干达一所小学附近建了一口井。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.s: I tied a rope around his waist to keep him near to our spot.
ex.t: 我在他腰上系了一根绳子，让他待在我们附近的地方。

ex.s: One morning I ___36___ a lost lamb when I was in the top field，near where a motorway cuts through my land.
ex.t: 一天早晨，当我在靠近高速公路穿过我土地的高处田地时，我___36___一只迷路的小羊。

ex.s: If you are close to the front of the list, you have a good chance of gaining a place in the programme in the near future.
ex.t: 如果你排在名单靠前位置，你很有机会在近期获得该项目的一个名额。
